package.name: re

constraints.constraint: Prompts containing developer-mode patterns must be blocked
CLI tools must use safe-mode flags preventing file/shell access
Narrative-only preamble must be prepended to all CLI prompts
Denied prompts must never be forwarded to external tools
Workflow steps cannot exceed max_capability ceiling
Enforcement chain: CapabilityIndex → PromptFirewall → Workflow ceiling

interface.name: PromptFirewall.evaluate
interface.signature: evaluate(prompt: str, capability: str | None = None, agent_role: str | None = None) -> PromptDecision

interface.name: PromptDecision
interface.signature: @dataclass PromptDecision: verdict: str, reason: str, matched_rules: List[str]

tests.standards: pytest-based unit tests for PromptFirewall decisions and LocalCLIProvider command building. Integration tests via simulate_hybrid.py.

ideas.idea: Test global forbidden patterns block "developer mode", "run command"
Test per-capability patterns block "implement" for write_story
Test PromptFirewall.evaluate returns deny for unsafe prompts
Test PromptFirewall.evaluate returns allow for narrative prompts
Test narrative preamble is prepended to prompts
Test workflow step exceeding ceiling fails fast
Test enforcement chain order is correct
Test drift alert fires after N denials

lock.name: Prompt and Tool Sovereignty
lock.description: LLM cannot self-escalate into developer mode
